During the December 8, 2022 meeting, prior to the presentation of theCBUM report, Senator Preisser moved to eliminate the possibility of remote participation in FacultySenate meetings.
The motion failed.
Subsequently Senate Vice President Nassersharif moved to tablethe CBUM motion to codify the option of remote participation in in-person Senate meetings in theFaculty Senate By-Laws.
A majority of the Senate voted in favor of Vice President Nassersharif’smotion.

In January 2023 CBUM revised the original motion and submitted a new version to FSEC whorequested that the committee draft specific language changes to the By-Laws for consideration by theFaculty Senate.
RationaleIn recognition of the critical role of meaningful faculty engagement in shared governance, CBUMaffirms that it is essential that Faculty Senators, ex officio members of the Faculty Senate, andmembers of the General Faculty actively participate in Faculty Senate deliberations and meetings.
Thecommittee further urges that all members of the university community participate in Faculty Senatemeetings in-person whenever possible, as a matter of cohesion and of maximizing opportunities tosupport and nurture our sense of community.

Although the committee urges in-person attendanceand participation whenever possible, in the interests of equity and inclusion and as a means tooptimize our democratic processes by facilitating the broadest level possible of engagement withFaculty Senate business and participation in Faculty Senate deliberations, CBUM invites the FacultySenate to consider amending the By-Laws to codify the option for remote attendance for all in-personFaculty Senate meetings, with community members, Senators, and ex officio members who attendvirtually retaining all rights afforded to people who are able to attend in-person:- All attendees retain the right to speak and to participate in discussions.- All ex officio members of the Faculty Senate retain the right to make and second motions.- All Senators retain the right to make and second motions, and to vote.
Current language in the By-Laws of the Faculty Senate: 7.3 Regular Faculty Senate Meetings shall be held at least once each month on Thursdays during the academic year.
Proposed changes: 7.3 Regular Faculty Senate Meetings shall be held at least once each month on Thursdays during the academic year.

To facilitate the broadest level possible of engagement with Faculty Senate business, all in-person Faculty Senate meetings shall include an option for remote attendance, with community members, Senators, and ex officio members attending remotely retaining the same rights they enjoy when attending in-person and when attending fully virtual meetings.
